In March 2014, the Administration released its fiscal

and put the debt as a share of the economy on a declining

Session Review of the Fiscal Year 2015 Budget, the federal 
budget deficit is projected to decline from $680 billion (4.1 
percent of GDP) in fiscal year 2013 to $583 billion (3.4 
percent of GDP) in fiscal year 2014 and $525 billion

projected to average 2.5 percent of GDP from fiscal 
year 2015 through fiscal year 2024. The primary deficit 
(non-interest outlays less receipts) will become a primary 
surplus in fiscal year 2021 and grow through the end of the 
forecast horizon. The debt-to-GDP ratio is projected to peak 
at 74.6 percent in fiscal year 2015 and then begin to decline, 
falling to 72.0 percent of GDP by fiscal year 2024 
(equivalent to its fiscal year 2013 level).
